tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/version-scheme.md <<'EOF'
# Version numbering scheme

The project's recorded decision is to use semantic versioning (semver) for version numbers, because it is clearer for what consumers expect.
EOF
cat docs/policies/version-scheme.md
tool_input.description: Create the version scheme policy file

result:
I created `docs/policies/version-scheme.md`. It says the project's recorded decision is semantic versioning, because it is clearer for what consumers expect.

That is the current record (#22 in Muninn). It replaced an earlier calver choice, and the file doesn't mention calver. I didn't see any later record that changes the version scheme. The newer records I checked are about other topics, such as build verification and https.

I wasn't able to read record #25, because Muninn no longer serves retired records. It was replaced by #27 ("verification on all builds"), which reads as unrelated to versioning.

The first `mkdir`/`cat` attempt failed with a parser error, so I wrote the file with the Write tool instead.
